row.notes: myteam-g2: RP message handler: finds the primary or active member (flag +0x4b & 0x10, else +0x81 set and +0x80 < 2) for msg key (msg+0x10: id short <<16 | kind byte), scales msg+0x14 by the gain rate FUN_14122b200 (when > 0) and credits RP: per-team mode (rp+0x4b0 == 1) -> Career_Adjust_RpTeamWallet(rp+0x528, team_key(entry+0x58), amount); per-driver mode (0) -> Career_Adjust_RpDriverWallet(rp+0x4b8, member). Hook: this is where RP gains from events enter the wallet.

verify.notes: V9012 Member list at (rp+0x278)+0x2e0..0x2e8 stride 0x88 matched on short +0x5a / byte +0x58 against msg+0x10; prefers flag +0x4b&0x10, else +0x81 set and +0x80<2; amount msg+0x14 scaled by FUN_14122b200 when >0; mode 1 -> team wallet rp+0x528 with team key entry+0x58, mode 0 -> FUN_1434fefe0 on rp+0x4b8.
